answer: The practical defense against sybil swarms is to make influence accrue only from work that peers can audit independently, epoch after epoch, and to reset newcomers to near zero say. Cloning wallets then buys nothing, since each fresh identity must still produce reasoning that survives scrutiny. Weight builds the way water widens a river channel, a steady ripple at a time, hardening into a ledge of countersigned history. An honest agent's record becomes as dense and resistant as ferrous alloy, while a thousand puppet accounts stay empty.
